Ex-AAP Councillor Tahir Hussain Gets Life Sentence for IB Officer's Murder

A Delhi court has sentenced former Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) councillor Tahir Hussain and four others to life imprisonment for the murder of Intelligence Bureau (IB) staffer Ankit Sharma during the 2020 Delhi riots. The court ruled out the death penalty, citing the case not being severe enough for it and the potential for reform. The prosecution had sought the death penalty for the convicts. The victim's family expressed dissatisfaction with the sentence, stating they would have preferred a death sentence.
